permissions: Invoice read/write token abilities plus customer ownership

dataLifecycle: One creation intent per invoice; stable namespace/order/expiry/payload before HTTP
Completion and charge audit update atomically
Persistent notification inbox plus scheduled recovery
failures: No automatic second create after ambiguous response
Provider errors leave invoices unpaid and never trigger card-decline dunning
Unknown orders acknowledged without cross-project effects
Underpayment, mismatched amount/currency or transaction reuse require reconciliation
acceptanceCriteria: Mocked HTTP regression tests cover creation, reuse, expiry/unknown outcomes, payment_check, forged/duplicate/replayed events and provider downtime

No live link creation or payment, no credentials in tracked files

assumptions: Confirmation means hosted link payments each cycle, not automatic card debits.
Initial invoice timing, upgrade invoice model and degraded invoice repricing remain unchanged.
A merchant API key is required to request single_payment and expiry options; legacy handle-only multi-use links are not issued.
The JBoot Go adapter is a contract/configuration reference; this implementation stays native Laravel.
